column32: The Guizhou Development and Reform Commission issued “17 policies and measures to support service industry market players to actively respond to the pandemic.” According to the document, for employers in the service industry who lay off none or few employees, 50% of the unemployment insurance premium paid last year will be returned. On the other hand, for those employers who are facing operational difficulties and are expected to recover, if they insist on no or fewer layoffs, they can receive a refund of six-month unemployment insurance premium (calculated using either local average of the unemployment insurance premium or 50% of the firm’s actual unemployment insurance premium). column36: The Guizhou Development and Reform Commission published “17 policy measures to support service industry to actively respond to the pandemic.” According to the document, Large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises must exempt rents for small/medium-sized enterprises and individual businesses that lease land/property from them. PDF archive available upon request

The Guizhou Development and Reform Commission published “Notice on the implementation of supportive electricity price policy for enterprises during the period of pandemic prevention and control.” According to the document, for enterprises expanding production capacity to meet the needs of epidemic prevention and control, they need not to pay extra fees if they use more electricity than do their contracts entail; for enterprises that cannot open and resume work due to the pandemic control and lockdown, some basic electricity charges (starting from February 1, 2020) will be exempted. Additionally, from February to March of 2020, small and medium-sized companies that fail to pay electricity bill will not experience electricity shutdown. They can repay those electricity bills two months after the pandemic control ends, no extra fees collected due to payment delay.     PDF archive available upon request

column41: From 11 January, 2020 to 20 January, 2020, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China forwarded the report of the Wuhan Municipal Health Commission on viral pneumonia of unknown cause. column43: On 20 January, 2020, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China announced that it has established a "daily report and zero report" system for epidemic situation in the whole country, and delivered novel coronavirus nucleic acid test kit to local governments, requiring all localities to strengthen testing, spare no effort to treat patients, and timely release information about confirmed cases and epidemic prevention and control.  From 21 January, 2020, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China began to uniformly report the pneumonia epidemic situation of novel coronavirus in all provinces of the country on the official website.  https://archive.vn/NMhHZ  https://web.archive.org/web/20210404080831/https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1656341561742146551&wfr=spider&for=pc   https://archive.vn/LWs9d

column41: On 20 January, 2020, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China held a press conference, on which the high-level expert group answered questions about the pneumonia epidemic in novel coronavirus  Besides that, at that time, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China had established an official information release platform about the novel coronavirus epidemic.  https://archive.vn/QrreI  https://archive.vn/LHbKK

column9: The Harbin Education Bureau announced that since March 14 2022, some primary and secondary schools in Harbin will switch from offline teaching to online teaching. The details are as follows. Daowai District continues to implement online teaching; Daoli District, Nangang District, Xiangfang District, Pingfang District, Songbei District, Shuangcheng District, and Wuchang City primary and secondary schools (including secondary vocational schools) will switch from offline teaching to online teaching; the remaining ten districts and counties (cities) will be assessed by the local epidemic situation headquarters and decide whether to switch between online and offline teaching in primary and secondary schools within the jurisdiction. All kindergartens in the city will be closed, and all kinds of off-campus education and training institutions will stop teaching offline. In addition, all colleges and universities within the administrative area of Harbin will implement closed management; students do not leave school or leave Harbin. The resumption of offline teaching will be announced later.    In addition, on March 15, the Heilongjiang Provincial Civil Service Bureau and the Heilongjiang Provincial Personnel Examination Center issued an announcement, deciding to postpone the 2022 written examination for civil servants in Heilongjiang Province, which was originally scheduled to be held on March 26 and 27. The restart time of the written test and related arrangements will be notified separately according to the epidemic prevention and control situation.    See The Paper news website. column12: From the Announcement No. 53 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since March 14 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    First, chess and card room (mahjong hall), bath, cinema, theater, karaoke hall, dance hall, bar, pedicure shop, massage parlor, game hall, Internet cafe, script killing, board game bar, library, escape room, indoor sports and fitness place, indoor children amusement projects, small hotels located in basements or semi-basements, various offline education and training institutions and other places with relatively closed spaces will be temporarily closed. Religious sites will be temporarily closed.     Secondly, Individual clinics will be closed. Welfare institutions, old-age service institutions, and mental health institutions implement will be under fully closed management, and personnel will be prohibited from entering and leaving. Aged care institutions will suspend the admission of newly admitted elderly people and stop visiting activities. The public security, judicial and administrative prisons will be under closed management, and family members who have direct contact will be suspended from visiting.    Thirdly, all construction sites under construction will be under closed management, and the employees of enterprises and institutions will not be allowed to leave the resident and operating sites unless necessary, and will strictly implement the "two points and one line" commuting mode.    Fourthly, various administrative enterprises and institutions at all levels will start to implement flexible working system, staggered commute to and from get off work, and actively advocate online office and home office as well. Comprehensively implement measures such as nucleic acid testing and screening, daily ventilation and disinfection, and daily health monitoring of employees.     Fifthly, all social catering service units (including food sales units that provide dine-in) will suspend dine-in, but can provide in-store pick-up and take-out ordering services; encourage the implementation of "contactless" delivery.    See The Paper news website.    Archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20220316162526/https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17127569

column12: From the Announcement No. 58 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter, since April 11 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    1. Harbin city's daily consumer goods wholesale and retail markets, commercial complexes, department stores, bookstores, libraries, museums, science and technology museums, cultural centers, art galleries and other places and non-productive business activities such as consulting services, insurance agents, and legal services are orderly resume business. Staff and customers wear masks at all times.    3. Municipal, district (city) organs and institutions resume flexible office work, and strictly implement the "two points and one line" commuting mode. Strictly implement "scanning code (health code + itinerary code), temperature measurement, wearing mask" for all entering personnel, and check the negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours.    4. The number of guests should not exceed 50% of the full capacity. Enterprises and the masses are encouraged to conduct business through non-direct contact methods such as online and self-service. Actively advocate the appointment of urgent matters and postpone the handling of non-urgent matters.    5. Harbin city's water, electricity, gas and communications and other public institutions resume offline payment in an orderly manner. However, it is necessary to strictly implement various prevention and control measures such as peak shifting and current limiting, daily disinfection, and employee health monitoring. column9: From the Announcement the Harbin Education Bureau, since April 12 2022, the following policies will be implemented. Commercial complexes, department stores, daily consumer wholesale and retail markets, building decoration materials markets, and automobile and spare parts business, consulting services, insurance agents, and legal service venues will resume in an orderly manner under the premise of strictly implementing epidemic prevention and control measures. operate. Games and entertainment, beauty and fitness, training institutions, theaters and other ancillary projects and areas in the venue will be temporarily resumed. The city's water, electricity, gas, and communications and other public institutions will resume necessary offline payment in an orderly manner. column34: At the press conference on "relevant information on policies and measures for financial assistance to enterprises in Heilongjiang Province" held by the Information Office of the people's Government of Heilongjiang Province, since June 2nd 2022, the following policies will be implemented.    Affected by the epidemic, the production and operation of some profit-making enterprises in Heilongjiang Province fell into difficulties or even stopped. At the same time, personal mortgage customers have difficulties in repayment. On June 2, LiuXiaoHui, deputy director of Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau, said that Heilongjiang banking and insurance regulatory bureau had implemented the policy requirements of the CBRC at the press conference on "relevant information on policies and measures for financial assistance to enterprises in Heilongjiang Province" held by the Information Office of Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government. Implement the policy of delaying the repayment of principal and interest for the groups affected by the epidemic. Ensure continuous loan and no pressure on loan.    LiuXiaoHui said that for small, medium-sized and micro enterprises (including owners of small, medium-sized and micro enterprises), individual industrial and commercial households, truck drivers and other production and operation entities, Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau has made great efforts to extend their loans as long as possible, so as to ensure the employment of market entities.    For those who have been hospitalized or isolated due to infection with COVID-19 and have lost their source of income due to the impact of the epidemic, Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau has flexibly adjusted the repayment plan for their existing personal housing, consumption and other loans and exempted them from penalty interest. Especially since the beginning of this year, in view of the repeated epidemic situation in the whole province, the pressure on epidemic prevention and control has increased, and some residents have difficulties in repaying their mortgage loans. In April, Heilongjiang banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau issued the notice on doing a good job in mortgage loan relief for customers affected by the epidemic, requiring banking financial institutions within their jurisdiction to make every effort to do a good job in mortgage loan relief for residents affected by the epidemic.    First, accurate portraits. Banking financial institutions should attach great importance to it, strengthen their organizational leadership, implement their work responsibilities and improve their working mechanisms. Accurately identify customers' conditions, enrich handling channels and optimize handling processes.    The second is to make rational use of rescue methods. Financial institutions in the banking sector have taken such relief measures as flexibly adjusting mortgage loan repayment arrangements, reasonably delaying the repayment period, protecting the relevant rights and interests of the public in credit investigation, and other legally compliant and risk controllable support methods. Further enrich financial service measures to effectively alleviate the repayment pressure of customers.    Third, increase policy publicity. Banking financial institutions publicize policies through websites, apps, outlets and other forms.    Fourth, provide follow-up services. Banking institutions should strengthen communication and explain the repayment to customers after the change. Show the repayment plan in detail, and effectively protect the customer's right to know. Make timely feedback on relevant consultation and complaint information.    See People's Daily Online website. column27: From the latest regulations of travel to and from Harbin published on August 2nd, the following policies will be implemented. This announcement will come into force on the date of issuance.    1. Each station in Harbin  Arriving at the station: All passengers departing from Kazakhstan will only check the Longjiang health code, not the nucleic acid report.  Outbound:  (1) Passengers arriving in Kazakhstan (non-port cities) will only check the Longjiang health code when they leave the station, not the nucleic acid report.  (2) When passengers from outside the province and port cities within the province arrive and leave the station, they will still verify the 48-hour nucleic acid report (either electronic or paper version) and on-the-spot nucleic acid testing.    2. Airport  Come to Harbin:  (1) For all returnees to Kazakhstan, the nucleic acid test report within 48 hours of landing inspection (paper, electronic, screenshot, mixed inspection, and single inspection are all acceptable)  (2) With the code scanning and temperature measurement, you can leave normally if the green code and the temperature are normal.  (3) Actively report to the community and implement other epidemic prevention policies  (4) If you want to travel to Kazakhstan, you need to report to the hotel where you live or the community where the hotel is located.    From Harbin:  Harbin Airport will no longer check the nucleic acid test report, but it is necessary to consult the airline's epidemic prevention requirements in advance. Passengers going to Beijing need to check whether Beijing Healthbao has a green code in advance. If there is an abnormality, they cannot go.    3. High-speed epidemic control situation  (1) Harbin Ring Expressway:  Harbin East Station exit control (returning to Harbin truck personnel report to the area or freight yard they are going to in advance, and do a free nucleic acid test within 24 hours, and free nucleic acid + antigen test in medium and high-risk areas)  (2) Hatong Expressway:  Tongjiang station exit control (inspection at the epidemic prevention card point, personnel entering Tongjiang need to hold a nucleic acid test report within 48 hours and landing nucleic acid test) Tongjiang station entrance control (epidemic prevention card point, scan double code, temperature measurement, registration, all vehicles need Negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours)    4. Harbin quarantine control measures    (1) If one or more cases of local positive infection are reported in China, if the risk area of ??the epidemic has not been adjusted, and it is not clear whether there is a risk of community transmission and spillover, the county (city, district, banner) where the case was reported will travel and live within 7 days Personnel from history and returnees will immediately conduct investigations, establish risk personnel management files, and implement 3-day 2-inspection measures for personnel management and control measures in counties (cities, districts, and flags) where the medium and high-risk areas are located.  (2) For those who have a history of living in high-risk areas within 7 days, take 7-day centralized isolation medical observation, carry out nucleic acid testing on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, and 7th days of centralized isolation, and the management period starts from leaving the risk area. rise.  (3) For those who have lived in medium-risk areas within 7 days, take 7-day home isolation medical observation, and conduct a nucleic acid test on the 1st, 4th, and 7th days of home isolation medical observation. If you do not have the conditions for home isolation medical observation, centralized isolation medical observation is adopted; the management period starts from leaving the risk area.  (4) For those who live in low-risk areas within 7 days, complete two nucleic acid tests within 3 days (sampling interval is 24 hours), and conduct health monitoring.  (5) For those who have a history of living in other counties (cities, districts, banners) in the cities (or municipalities directly under the Central Government) where the medium and high risk areas are located within 7 days, a free nucleic acid test shall be conducted as soon as possible within 24 hours after arriving at the destination.  (6) Persons with a history of living in low, medium or high-risk areas within 7 days, or those who have not adjusted the local risk area, but who have returned from the county (city, district, banner) where the local epidemic occurred, must report to the locality 2 days before arrival. Community (village) and unit reports (such as temporary return trips to be reported in advance as soon as possible). Report to the local community (village) and unit (or hotel) as soon as possible and no more than 12 hours after arrival, and the local epidemic prevention and control command department will implement the control measures at different levels. Persons with a history of sojourn and residence in low-risk areas refer to persons with a history of sojourn and residence in counties (city district flags) of cities (or municipalities directly under the Central Government) where medium- and high-risk areas are located.    See The Harbin local news website. column24: From the Announcement No. 75 of Harbin's COVID-19 Work Headquarter:  According to the changes in the current epidemic situation and the mutation of the virus, the optimization measures for the scientific and accurate implementation of the ninth edition of the national prevention and control plan, the 20 Articles and the "New Ten Articles". After research and judgment by the expert group, the municipal headquarters decided to optimize and adjust the city's epidemic prevention and control measures. From 12:00 a.m. on December 8, 2022, the following policies will be implemented.     1. Asymptomatic infected persons and mild cases who meet the conditions for home isolation and do not have serious underlying diseases are generally subject to home isolation, or they can voluntarily choose centralized isolation for treatment. Strengthen health monitoring during the isolation period. On the 6th and 7th day of isolation, two consecutive nucleic acid tests with a Ct value = 35 will be released from isolation. If the condition worsens, transfer to a designated hospital for treatment in time.    2. Close contacts who are eligible for home isolation are subject to home isolation for 5 days, or they can voluntarily choose centralized isolation. After the nucleic acid test was negative on the fifth day, the isolation was lifted. For close contacts who are currently in centralized isolation and meet the conditions for home isolation, they can return to their place of residence in a "point-to-point" closed loop, and implement follow-up home isolation medical observation.    3. People in home isolation should live alone or in a single room. Try to use a separate bathroom and take personal protection. Minimize contact with other family members. During the period of home isolation, I and my co-residents are not allowed to go out.    4. For positive infections, medical observers in centralized or home isolation, and co-residents, the Longjiang Health Code will be assigned a "red code" for management. Timely decoding of medical observations for cure or release of isolation, other personnel will no longer be assigned codes for management.    5. High-risk areas are defined by buildings, units, floors, and households, and shall not be expanded to areas such as residential areas, communities, and streets (townships) at will. All forms of temporary blockade shall not be adopted. If there is no risk of community transmission, high-risk areas may not be designated.    6. After the high-risk areas are demarcated, the community must immediately inform the residents of the isolation and control time. Nucleic acid tests were performed on the fifth day of isolation for personnel in high-risk areas, and the quarantine was released in time after the results were negative. In case of secondary cases, only the residents with secondary positive cases shall be controlled, and the control time of other personnel shall not be extended.    7. It is strictly forbidden to block fire exits, unit doors, and community doors in various ways. Ensure that the channels for people to go out to see a doctor, seek medical treatment, and avoid danger are unobstructed.    See The Paper news website. column55: A-key workers  On January 17, 2021, the Jilin Provincial Health Commission held a press conference to announce that Jilin Province is organizing the new crown vaccination work for key populations,including A and B. Currently, there are five types of key populations vaccinated against the new crown: First, the port line of imported cold chain goods Customs inspection and quarantine personnel, port loading and unloading, handling, transportation and other related personnel; second, international and domestic transportation personnel; third, personnel working and studying abroad for business or private purposes, and border port staff who are facing a higher risk of overseas epidemics; The fourth is medical and health personnel; the fifth is urban operation guarantee personnel.     Jilin Province has carried out the new crown vaccine for key populations on a voluntary and free principle. The vaccinated population should be between 18-59 years old and there is no contraindication to vaccination. Currently, Jilin Province has raised 177 million yuan in funds to purchase the new crown vaccine and has ordered 1.324 million doses. A support mechanism for medical institutions and vaccination units above the second level has been established to ensure vaccination safety, and vaccination work is proceeding in an orderly manner.    http://web.archive.org/web/20210604093521/https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1689294564763295055&wfr=spider&for=pc  https://web.archive.org/web/20210406123753/https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1689294564763295055&wfr=spider&for=pc

column41: From 11 January, 2020 to 20 January, 2020, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China forwarded the report of the Wuhan Municipal Health Commission on viral pneumonia of unknown cause. It can be inferred that public officials are urging caution about the viral pneumonia of unknown cause. column43: On 20 January, 2020, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China announced that it has established a "daily report and zero report" system for epidemic situation in the whole country, and delivered novel coronavirus nucleic acid test kit to local governments, requiring all localities to strengthen testing, spare no effort to treat patients, and timely release information about confirmed cases and epidemic prevention and control.  From 21 January, 2020, National Health Commission of the People’s Republic of China began to uniformly report the pneumonia epidemic situation of novel coronavirus in all provinces of the country on the official website.  https://archive.vn/NMhHZ  https://web.archive.org/web/20210404080831/https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1656341561742146551&wfr=spider&for=pc   https://archive.vn/LWs9d

(3) Adjust the "7-day centralized isolation" to "7-day home isolation" for spillover personnel in high-risk areas, during which code management is assigned and must not go out. Nucleic acid tests were carried out on the 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 7th days of home isolation.    (4) Adjust the risk area from "high, medium, and low" to "high and low" to minimize control personnel. In principle, areas such as the place of residence of infected persons and work places and activity places with frequent activities and high risk of epidemic transmission are designated as high-risk areas, and high-risk areas are generally delimited by units and buildings, and must not be arbitrarily expanded; Other areas of the county (city, district, banner) where the high-risk area is located are designated as low-risk areas. column41: The Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism of the State Council held a press conference on 11/12/2021. China will stick with its “dynamic” zero-case policy over the winter and spring amid uncertainty over the effectiveness of vaccines against the new Omicron variant. The dynamic zero-case policy aims to prevent viral transmission in communities and find out and treat patients as soon as possible. With this strategy, China can control recent flare-ups and minimise mortality and serious illness while the economy has not been affected by related measures in terms of GDP growth rate and other indicators. column32: On 27 February,2020, The people's Government of Tibet announced the following policies: first, for the insured enterprises with no or less layoffs, 60% of the unemployment insurance premium actually paid in the previous year would be returned. Second, enterprises that are temporarily difficult in production and operation but were expected to recover would be subsidized according to the monthly per capita unemployment insurance and the number of insured employees for six months. Third, from February 2020, the basic endowment insurance, unemployment insurance and work-related injury insurance of small and medium-sized enterprises would be exempted for no more than five months. Fourth, the payment of basic endowment insurance, unemployment insurance and work-related injury insurance of large enterprises and other insured units (excluding government organs and institutions) could be reduced by half, and the period of reduction should not exceed three months. Fifthly, enterprises with serious difficulties in production and operation affected by the epidemic might apply for a delay in payment of social insurance premiums. In principle, the period of delay should not exceed six months, and late payment fees should be exempted during the period of delay. See Tibet Government website, archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20210202123845/http://mw.xizang.gov.cn/xwzx/xzxw/202003/t20200320_134898.html

column32: On February 3, 2020, Yunnan Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security issued a notice on the handling of labor relations issues during the epidemic prevention and control period    The circular pointed out the issue of subsidies for job stability. For enterprises participating in unemployment insurance that do not lay off employees or less, 50% of their actual unemployment insurance premiums paid in the previous year will be returned to them. Enterprises in poverty-stricken areas that have participated in unemployment insurance payments will be reimbursed at a rate of 60 percent.    For enterprises with temporary difficulties in production and management, the amount to be returned is determined by the average local unemployment insurance compensation of 6 months and the number of insured workers. column29: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the National Immigration Administration of the People's Republic of China issued an announcement on the temporary suspension of entry of foreigners holding valid Chinese visas and residence permits on March 26. The suspension -- starting on Saturday Mar 28 -- is a temporary measure that China is compelled to take in light of the outbreak situation and the practices of other countries, the announcement said. According to the announcement, entry by foreign nationals with APEC business travel cards will be suspended. Policies including port visas, 24/72/144-hour visa-free transit policy, Hainan 30-day visa-free policy, 15-day visa-free policy specified for foreign cruise-group-tour through Shanghai Port, Guangdong 144-hour visa-free policy specified for foreign tour groups from Hong Kong or Macao SAR, and Guangxi 15-day visa-free policy specified for foreign tour groups of ASEAN countries will also be temporarily suspended. Entry with diplomatic, service, courtesy or C visas will not be affected and foreign nationals coming to China for necessary economic, trade, scientific or technological activities or out of emergency humanitarian needs may apply for visas at Chinese embassies or consulates, the announcement said. Entry by foreign nationals with visas issued after this announcement will not be affected. column9: On April 29, the epidemic prevention and control headquarters of Ruili City issued a notice on the adjustment of the epidemic risk level, which means there is no high-risk area in Ruili. column52: On March 18,  National Health Commission of the People's Republic of China issued a guidance on mask wearing. Medical masks and surgical masks are sufficient for normal use, and wearing multiple masks does not provide more protection, according to the guideline. The public is advised to carry along masks when in crowded places such as offices, shopping malls, restaurants, workshops and public transport. People in high-risk areas should wear surgical masks all the time when entering such places, while those in medium-risk and low-risk areas need to wear medical masks when in contact with others at the distance of less than 1 meter. Those who have cold symptoms such as coughing or sneezing, or who live with personnel in quarantine or that have recovered from the novel coronavirus and been discharged from the hospital, are suggested to wear disposable medical or surgical masks. People working in places such as hospitals, train terminals, airports, prisons and nursing homes need to wear surgical masks or respirators of grade KN95/N95 or above. The suspected cases, confirmed cases of novel coronavirus, asymptomatic cases and those who have close contact with confirmed cases are recommended to wear surgical masks or respirators with no breathing valve graded at KN95/N95 or above. Entry personnel need to wear such masks from the moment they enter the country to the end of their required quarantine.    See National Health Commission of the People's Republic of China website, archived:   http://archive.today/2020.10.19-223608/http://www.nhc.gov.cn/jkj/s3577/202003/0a472cc09e744144883db6a74fe6e760.shtml    See Zhejiang Daily website, archived:   https://web.archive.org/web/20210214055653/http://zjrb.zjol.com.cn/html/2020-03/19/content_3315711.htm?div=-1

column9: On March 14, according to the needs of epidemic prevention and control, Quzhou took the following measures for Education:  1. All primary and secondary schools (including kindergartens) and training institutions at the municipal level and within the two districts will be suspended for one week, and the resumption time will be notified;  2. All students living in boarding schools are subject to the closed management of staying in school, and the general students are suspended from entering the school. Teachers should make scientific regulation and arrangement, and in principle, they can only enter and leave;  3. Colleges and universities and the Yangtze River Delta Research Institute of CETC implement closed management, and faculty and students can only enter and leave;  4. All primary and secondary schools at the municipal level and within the two districts have been adjusted to online teaching, kindergartens have stopped entering the park, and all kinds of training institutions have stopped carrying out offline training.  5. Schools in all localities should do a good job in the dynamic arrangement of the "three areas" involved in the epidemic, and actively cooperate with the implementation of various control measures of relevant personnel. Teachers and students in Kaihua, Qujiang sealed and controlled areas and controlled areas should be under the "14 + 7" control of the community, and teachers and students in the prevention area should be under the "2 + 14" control, which can be picked up by their parents. For students who cannot be picked up if they have difficulties, the school should implement the control measures in a single room.  During the suspension period, we will do a good job in suspension, online teaching services, mental health education for teachers and students and other related work.  http://archive.today/2022.03.15-154933/https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/dUGw4LKUF3jc8gyjPEpN0w

Temporarily shut down bars, KTVs, Internet cafes, chess and card rooms, mahjong rooms, board game rooms, recreation halls, video game halls, secret room escape, foot bath shops, ear picking shops, health salons, bathrooms, gyms, natatoriums, gymnasiums, cinemas, libraries, museums, cinemas and other closed public places in the city. column27: On June 8, the office of the leading group for the prevention and control of novel coronavirus pneumonia in Zhejiang Province issued the notice on scientifically and accurately adjusting the health management measures for Shanghai personnel who came to and returned to Zhejiang.  The "7-day centralized isolation medical observation +7-day home health observation" will be implemented for the township (street) where the middle and high-risk areas in Shanghai are located or the township (street) who have local social face positive cases in 7 days. During the home health observation, nucleic acid detection was performed once on the 2nd and 7th day respectively.  The "7-day routine health monitoring" will be implemented for those who come to Zhejiang and return to Zhejiang from the districts where the middle and high-risk areas in Shanghai are located or where there are local social face positive cases within 7 days. During daily health monitoring, nucleic acid detection shall be carried out once in the first, second, third and seventh days respectively, and the requirements for local normalized nucleic acid detection shall be met.  "7-day routine health monitoring" was carried out for the personnel from other regions in Shanghai who came to and returned to Zhejiang. During daily health monitoring, nucleic acid detection shall be carried out once in the first and seventh days respectively, and the requirements for local normalized nucleic acid detection shall be met.  During the daily health monitoring, the above personnel are required to control the scope of activities, do not take public transport, do not participate in gatherings such as conferences, exhibitions, tourism and dinners, do not enter schools, nurseries, nursing homes, welfare homes and other specific institutions, do not enter indoor closed places such as cinemas, dance halls, bathrooms and Internet cafes, do not carry out offline teaching, training and other activities, and must wear masks in the whole process when going out, Keep a safe social distance, and in principle, do not leave the county (city, district) before ending the daily health monitoring.    http://archive.today/2022.06.08-125704/https://m.gmw.cn/2022-06/08/content_1302987248.htm

column9: Since 0:00 on August 11, Yiwu has implemented silent management. The whole city (except Dachen, Chian and high-risk areas) is controlled by reference to the medium risk area (control area standard). Among them, the high-risk area (sealed area) implements the "door-to-door service without leaving the house", the living materials are distributed to the households, and the nucleic acid sampling is carried out at the door. In other areas, the policy of "not leaving the area" is implemented. The living materials are delivered to the point, the wrong time is taken and the nucleic acid sampling is carried out. The mask is worn throughout the whole process. It is strictly prohibited to gather. 1. Strictly control public places. All public places in Yiwu, except medical institutions and basic livelihood guarantee units, have been suspended. 2. Industrial and key logistics enterprises have conditions to start construction. Some industrial and key logistics enterprises that meet the closed-loop management conditions are allowed to carry out closed-loop production and operation, and other industrial and commercial enterprises are allowed to suspend production and operation activities. 3. Strict management of special institutions. Schools and off campus educational and training institutions suspend offline teaching; Nursing homes, children's welfare homes, places of religious activities, etc. are temporarily closed; The administrative service center implements online office. 4. Strict inspection and control of intercity traffic checkpoints. In principle, other vehicles can not enter or leave Yiwu except those that guarantee life, production and anti epidemic. 5. Gathering activities are strictly prohibited. All gatherings such as exhibitions, promotions and square dances will be suspended. Family and friends are strictly forbidden to get together for dinner. https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Ijs9_NFgB5NpVqtwFSoeVg  http://archive.today/2022.08.24-152809/https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Ijs9_NFgB5NpVqtwFSoeVg

column12: Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, issued a notice on August 16. From now on, all counties (cities and districts) with local positive infection will suspend business for 3 days for bars, KTVs, screenplays, cinemas, Internet cafes, gyms, chess and card rooms, bathing places and other closed space entertainment places in the relevant areas. Strictly control aggregate activities. The number and scale of activities shall be strictly controlled in accordance with the principle of "no non critical activities, no online activities and no offline activities". The organizers of meetings and activities with more than 50 people need to formulate epidemic prevention and control plans and strictly implement various prevention and control measures. In principle, large-scale conferences, exhibitions, cultural activities, sports events and other crowd gathering activities with more than 200 people will be temporarily suspended.   http://archive.today/2022.08.24-152940/https://news.sina.com.cn/c/2022-08-16/doc-imizirav8399125.shtml%23/

column9: The COVID-19 epidemic prevention and control headquarters of Yiwu City decided to remove some quiet management areas from 0:00 on August 18, 2022. Farmers' markets, supermarkets, convenience stores, barbers' shops, laundries and other livelihood service places will be restored in an orderly manner. Farmers' markets and supermarkets will be opened to the public at 30% of their capacity. All catering establishments will continue to suspend in-house food, and only provide self-service and take out service. Each business entity shall strictly implement the responsibility of epidemic prevention and control, strictly prevent personnel from gathering, urge the admission personnel to wear masks, scan the site code, check the health code, travel card and nucleic acid negative certificate within 24 hours. Closed places such as chess and card room, bathing (shower), foot massage shop, KTV, bar, Internet bar and game hall will continue to be closed; Training institutions and kindergartens continue to suspend offline teaching; Pension service institutions, welfare institutions and rescue management institutions continue to implement closed management. All kinds of religious sites continue to implement the "double suspension" (suspending the opening of sites and all collective religious activities). Strictly control all kinds of meetings and activities, and temporarily do not hold large-scale conferences, forums, exhibitions, wedding banquets, night markets and other gathering activities. We advocate that weddings should be postponed, funerals should be simplified, and banquets should not be held.  http://archive.today/2022.08.24-152737/https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20220817A0AGGE00.html

column52: Although some places have stricter regulations on wearing facial masks in all the public spaces, the majority of cities require masks on in certain public spaces, mostly when using public transport. In situations of driving, staying alone, taking a walk and going to open spaces where is not crowded, it is fine to not wear a mask. column15: Measures announced on Sunday for the Tianshan district of Urumqi included mass health screenings, and some public transport and most flights into the city were stopped on Saturday. Group activities have been suspended and people were warned against unnecessary travel outside the city. District authorities have also “strengthened [housing] compound management”, including tighter controls over who goes in and out, carrying out a comprehensive disinfection of the public areas of the community, providing contactless delivery services and help purchasing daily necessities. Beijing, meanwhile, has gone 14 days without a case of local transmission, and city authorities on Sunday said they were downgrading the emergency response level from 2 to 3. The move is largely symbolic, with many measures remaining in place including mandatory social distancing, temperature checks and 14-day quarantines for passengers arriving from abroad.  https://web.archive.org/web/20210810021145/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jul/20/covid-19-outbreak-in-xinjiang-spreads-to-second-chinese-city

column55: This extended note aims to capture the progress on vaccination programme before it is rolled out to the entire country (does not include R&D, clinic trials).    The China National Medicine Products Administration (MPA) has not formally approved the Sinopharm Inactivated vaccine to go to the market. However, the green light is anticipated in the next few days.     http://web.archive.org/web/20201214212000/https://weareunited.com.my/11515744/    On 24 June 2020, the MPA approved the emergency use of COVID-19 vaccine. Voluntary vaccination started on around 17 June. The first batch of receivers consisted mainly of key workers, including state-owned enterprise employees who must go overseas to countries where the pandemic hits hard; medical staff, epidemic-control staff, border force and other essential workers who keep cities running.     http://web.archive.org/web/20201214231804/https://finance.sina.com.cn/chanjing/cyxw/2020-11-18/doc-iiznezxs2537217.shtml    From mid-October, Zhejiang province has offered vaccines to ordinary citizens on a voluntary basis. The rationale has been that many cities in Zhejiang have export-oriented economies; for example, Yiwu city is the world centre for light industry commodity trading. Many wholesale merchants were keen on receiving vaccines so that they can travel to Latin America and Africa to inspect their businesses. See BBC reports below. By mid-November, Zhejiang had provided vaccines to some 743,000 people. Voluntary vaccines were paid by recipients. Two doses cost roughly 400 CNY plus a service charge of around 56 CNY, which altogether equals to approximately 70 USD.     http://web.archive.org/web/20201214231741/https://www.bbc.com/zhongwen/simp/chinese-news-54628714    As the vaccination programme is yet to roll out to the whole country, there is no national policy on who will get the vaccine first. However, Sichuan province, where the most recent cluster of infection was found, did publish a detailed plan to that sets out the order:    The first group to receive vaccines consists of people facing high risks of infection, including medical staffs with International assistance mission, national health emergency rescue team in Sichuan, fever clinic and frontline doctors and nurses, border control force, frontline health inspection and epidemic-control officials, students or workers going overseas, police force, frozen food industry workers, essential workers for keeping cities running, teachers, other medical staffs, doctors and nurses, community social workers. The first batch is estimated to have 2 million people. Vaccination for them has started and will finish within 2020.    The second group to receive vaccines mainly consists of vulnerable people, including elderly people and people with chronic diseases. Vaccination for them will start from early next year (January).    The third batch will open to the general public. Ordinary people are estimated to start receiving vaccines after the Chinese New Year (12 February 2021).    http://web.archive.org/web/20201214221555/https://www.sohu.com/a/437018675_114988    So far, vaccination is not and is unlike to be paid by social medical insurance funds in the future. The National Health Security Administration has cited laws and regulations as the justification that vaccination is a part of public health effort, which should be shouldered by public finance resources, rather than social medical insurance funds.     http://web.archive.org/web/20201214211226/https://www.sohu.com/a/425495553_114986    UAE and Bahrain have formally approved the Sinopharm vaccine on 9th and 13th December 2020 respectively.    http://web.archive.org/web/20201214231619/http://www.xinhuanet.com/2020-12/09/c_1126842251.htm  http://web.archive.org/web/20201214231549/http://www.xinhuanet.com/world/2020-12/14/c_1126855787.htm

A:    China formally started to vaccinate group A - Key workers - and people who need to go to high-risk countries/regions to work and/or study on 15 Dec 2020. Key workers are those who work in frozen stuff-importing industry, border check, market for fresh meet and fish, public transportation, and hospital. Groups B and/or C will be the next to be vaccinated.    https://archive.vn/oG1an

column29: Are U.S. citizens permitted to enter?  Yes.  China currently allows foreign nationals with valid residence permits and visas to enter the country under certain very limited conditions. The U.S. Embassy has no say in these policies, and these are subject to change at any time.  As of December 23, 2020, travelers must complete PCR NAT and IgM antibody tests in the departure city. Please follow guidance on the PRC Embassy  website to identify approved labs.  Is a negative COVID-19 test required for entry?  Yes.  All inbound passengers are required to quarantine for at least 14 days upon arrival. Testing upon arrival and for release from quarantine may include blood tests, as well as oral, nasal, and anal swab tests.  On March 15, 2021, the Chinese Embassy in the United States announced updated visa facilitation procedures for certain applicants inoculated with Chinese COVID-19 vaccines. Please see the PRC Embassy  website (Chinese language only) for more information.  On April 16, 2021, the Chinese Embassy in Washington, D.C., announced new procedures for vaccinated travelers to China.  Please see the Chinese Embassy in Washington website  (Chinese language only) for more information.  Are health screening procedures in place at airports and other ports of entry?  Yes.  All Chinese visa related questions should be directed to the local Chinese Exit-Entry Bureau (EEB).  U.S. citizens in China on a visa or residence permit may contact the nearest office of the EEB to apply for an extension. Extensions are granted on a case-by-case basis.  In the event the local situation deteriorates, the U.S. Embassy and Consulates may have limited availability to provide assistance to U.S. nationals within China. The United States is not offering evacuation flights from China at this time.    https://archive.ph/mQwdP

column27: Travel in China  Mandatory requirements to check temperatures and use health kit apps or scan QR codes to prove travel history are in place at transport hubs, hotels, commercial buildings including restaurants, residential compounds and other locations.  Restrictions on movement and quarantine arrangements remain for travel between different parts of the country. Some cities and provinces need travellers from high to medium risk areas to undergo 14 days of isolation in their place of residence or in centralised observation. Quarantine and other COVID-19 measures, including PCR tests to enter public buildings, are enforced by local authorities and vary across China, so you should check in advance.  The possibility that local authorities impose mandatory lockdowns in response to fresh outbreaks is high. Such lockdowns may result in disruptions to medical and other basic services, including food delivery. You should ensure you have prepared additional food, water and medical supplies in case you are mandated to isolate at home.  There have been reports of individuals who have frequented bars or restaurants where there have been confirmed cases of COVID-19 being mandated to undergo 14 days of centralised quarantine. column29: Entry and Exit Requirements  Are there COVID-related entry requirements for U.S. citizens? Yes, China currently allows foreign nationals with valid residence permits and visas to enter the country under certain very limited conditions. The U.S. Embassy is not involved in the creation of these policies, and they are subject to change at any time.  Is a negative COVID-19 test (PCR and/or serology) required for entry??Yes, please follow guidance on the PRC Embassy  website to identify approved labs.  Are health screening procedures in place at airports and other ports of entry? Yes    Quarantine Information?  Are U.S. citizens required to quarantine??Yes, all travelers, including U.S. citizens who enter China, are screened upon arrival and subject to a minimum 10-day quarantine. While restrictions around domestic travel within China have eased, local quarantine requirements can vary significantly between cities, and regulations can change very quickly.  All international arrivals should be prepared to complete quarantine at a government-selected facility or hotel at their own expense, with no control over the amenities, even if they maintain a residence in China.  Cities and provinces within China may also require quarantine for domestic travelers, regardless of nationality.  U.S. citizens may also be required to install and use location-tracking software on their phones to access public spaces and businesses. Some private hospitals may refuse admittance to travelers who have been in the United States 14 days prior to entering China.  Please consult local authorities on specific quarantine requirements.  U.S. citizens in China should follow the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and Chinese health authorities’ guidance for prevention, signs and symptoms, and treatment.    https://web.archive.org/web/20221022165517/https://china.usembassy-china.org.cn/covid-19-information/
column32: What personal income tax preferential policies have been introduced to support epidemic prevention and control?    A: In order to support the epidemic prevention and control work, the state has issued the following preferential personal income tax policies:  First, the temporary work subsidies and bonuses obtained by medical staff and epidemic prevention workers participating in the epidemic prevention and control work in accordance with the standards stipulated by the government are exempt from personal income tax. The standards stipulated by the government include the subsidy and bonus standards stipulated by governments at all levels.  Temporary work subsidies and bonuses for personnel involved in epidemic prevention and control stipulated by the provincial and above provincial governments shall be implemented mutatis mutandis.  Second, the medicines, medical supplies and protective supplies (excluding cash) issued by the unit to individuals for the prevention of new coronary pneumonia are not included in wages and salaries, and are exempt from personal income tax.  The above policies will be implemented from January 1, 2020, and the deadline will be announced separately depending on the epidemic situation.    https://archive.ph/2Zsdu
column34: According to the "Several Measures on Responding to the New Coronary Pneumonia Epidemic and Supporting the Development of Market Entities' Relief" (hereinafter referred to as the "Measures") issued by Shenzhen Qianhai Administration Bureau on March 29, 2022, the "four upper" enterprises in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone (Four categories of enterprises above designated size, including industrial enterprises above designated size, construction enterprises with qualification grades, wholesale and retail catering enterprises above designated size, and national key service enterprises) will be subsidized for spending on purchasing and applying electronic sentinels to strengthen epidemic prevention and control. 50% of the electronic sentinel and antigen detection kits purchased by each enterprise will be subsidized, with a maximum of 30,000 yuan per enterprise.    https://archive.ph/SZ2Yx    What policies have been promulgated for providing financial discounts on loans to key enterprises guaranteed for epidemic prevention and control, and what are the requirements for using loan funds?    A: For the newly added corporate loans for epidemic prevention and control in 2020, on the basis of the special re-lending of the People's Bank of China to support financial institutions to provide credit with preferential interest rates, the central government will provide discount support, and the discount period will not exceed one year.  Requirements for using preferential loans: Loan companies enjoying discounted interest support shall not misappropriate credit funds to repay other debts of the company; shall not use funds for arbitrage activities such as financial investment and wealth management; shall not use funds for production and operation activities not related to epidemic prevention and control; Disobey the state's unified allocation of production materials. The credit line of financial institutions shall not exceed the scale of funds for relevant production and operation activities required by the enterprises on the list for epidemic prevention and control; the loan funds issued by special re-loans shall not be used for the general capital needs of the enterprises on the list; the existing loans shall not be withdrawn in advance for renewal. column29: Are U.S. citizens required to quarantine? [Yes, all travelers, including U.S. citizens who enter China, are screened upon arrival and subject to a minimum 10-day quarantine. While restrictions around domestic travel within China have eased, local quarantine requirements can vary significantly between cities, and regulations can change very quickly.  All international arrivals should be prepared to complete quarantine at a government-selected facility or hotel at their own expense, with no control over the amenities, even if they maintain a residence in China.  Cities and provinces within China may also require quarantine for domestic travelers, regardless of nationality.]    Archived link:  https://archive.ph/Qs68r
column32: What personal income tax preferential policies have been introduced to support epidemic prevention and control?    A: In order to support the epidemic prevention and control work, the state has issued the following preferential personal income tax policies:  First, the temporary work subsidies and bonuses obtained by medical staff and epidemic prevention workers participating in the epidemic prevention and control work in accordance with the standards stipulated by the government are exempt from personal income tax. The standards stipulated by the government include the subsidy and bonus standards stipulated by governments at all levels.  Temporary work subsidies and bonuses for personnel involved in epidemic prevention and control stipulated by the provincial and above provincial governments shall be implemented mutatis mutandis.  Second, the medicines, medical supplies and protective supplies (excluding cash) issued by the unit to individuals for the prevention of new coronary pneumonia are not included in wages and salaries, and are exempt from personal income tax.  The above policies will be implemented from January 1, 2020, and the deadline will be announced separately depending on the epidemic situation.      Archived link:  https://archive.ph/y5Mpl
column34: What policies have been promulgated for providing financial discounts on loans to key enterprises guaranteed for epidemic prevention and control, and what are the requirements for using loan funds?    A: For the newly added corporate loans for epidemic prevention and control in 2020, on the basis of the special re-lending of the People's Bank of China to support financial institutions to provide credit with preferential interest rates, the central government will provide discount support, and the discount period will not exceed one year.  Requirements for using preferential loans: Loan companies enjoying discounted interest support shall not misappropriate credit funds to repay other debts of the company; shall not use funds for arbitrage activities such as financial investment and wealth management; shall not use funds for production and operation activities not related to epidemic prevention and control; Disobey the state's unified allocation of production materials. The credit line of financial institutions shall not exceed the scale of funds for relevant production and operation activities required by the enterprises on the list for epidemic prevention and control; the loan funds issued by special re-loans shall not be used for the general capital needs of the enterprises on the list; the existing loans shall not be withdrawn in advance for renewal. Withdrawal of refinancing funds.      Archived link:  https://archive.ph/y5Mpl

column55: Are vaccines available in China for U.S. citizens to receive? [Yes]  The Chinese government has conditionally authorized several different vaccines that are currently available to foreigners residing in China. The two most commonly available, Sinopharm and Sinovac, have not yet received approval by the Food and Drug Administration of the United States. Sinopharm and Sinovac have received approval for emergency use by the World Health Organization (WHO). Please contact your local health authorities for information on available vaccines.    Archived link:  https://archive.ph/Qs68r

Where to get the new coronavirus vaccine?    The vaccination of the new coronavirus vaccine is carried out in the vaccination unit approved by the local health and health administrative department. Usually, the inoculation unit is located in the health service center, township health center or general hospital in the jurisdiction. If the vaccination involves some departments or enterprises with relatively concentrated key objects, some temporary vaccination units will be set up locally according to the situation.    The health administrative department or disease prevention and control agency in the jurisdiction will also announce the inoculation units that can vaccinate against the new coronavirus as required, including the location and service time. Please pay attention to the relevant information release platform.    Archived link:  https://archive.ph/tId49
